title: editor: cycle completion menu with tab in vi insert
body:
I noticed tabbing to scroll through the list of completions like in emacs mode didn't work in vi mode, so this replicates the same emacs behavior for vi mode.

I originally had this implementation more naive, where it was effectively just a copy&paste of the emacs implementation for the `handleViInsertKey` calls.

I had amp review the AGENTS.md again and came up with this. Now the two implementations are tightly coupled (at least for this subset)- I'm not sure if that's behavior we want, but I'll defer that decision to you.
